Name: Portal Cake Dog Replacement
Author: Rimheirts
Description:
[left]This mod replaces your cute little canine friend with the cake from Portal. It scoots awkwardly across the ground barking and caring on. Maybe this pore little guy was a failed experiment or maybe you should take a break from all those mushrooms.

I'm currently playing my game with the latest version along with 27 mods including this one, so in theory this mod shouldn't be able to break your game.

Installation Instructions:
Download the latest version of SMAPI
Download Content Patcher
Download the mod
Extract the archive to where your Stardew Valley game files are installed
DONE[/left]
